paragraphs: The discussion of the business of Entravision Communications Corporation and its wholly-owned subsidiaries, or Entravision or the Company, is as of the date of filing this report, unless otherwise indicated.
Entravision is a media and advertising technology company.

Our Media business owns and operates one of the largest groups of Spanish-language television and radio stations in the United States. Our mission is to serve our Latino audience as a trusted provider of news, information, and entertainment. We serve our advertisers by providing marketing capabilities across broadcast and digital media.

Our Advertising Technology & Services (ATS) business empowers advertisers, primarily mobile app developers, to grow their businesses globally. We provide programmatic advertising solutions through two brands. Smadex is our demand-side platform, which uses proprietary AI to automate media buying. Adwake is our performance-based digital marketing agency.
We manage and report our financial results through these two operating segments: media and ATS.

Our net revenue for the year ended December 31, 2025 was $447.6 million. Of this amount, revenue generated by our media segment accounted for approximately 39%, and revenue generated by our ATS segment accounted for approximately 61% of total revenue.

We own and/or operate one of the largest groups of Spanish-language television and radio stations in the United States. Our assets include 47 television stations and 44 radio stations. These stations are concentrated in 13 of the 20 highest-density Latino markets in the United States. We also provide digital marketing services for businesses targeting Latino consumers.

We believe the Latino market is a long-term driver of the U.S. economy. There are 68 million Latinos in the United States. This group accounted for 56 percent of total U.S. population growth between 2010 and 2024, according to the U.S. Census Bureau. The median age of U.S. Latinos is 31, roughly eight years younger than the non-Latino population. The U.S. Latino gross domestic product reached $4.0 trillion in 2023 and is growing more than twice as fast as the non-Latino U.S. economy, according to the Latino Donor Collaborative.

We connect advertisers to this important audience. Our Media segment is a single source for advertisers in our markets. We believe our local market presence and relationships enable us to act as a trusted partner for advertisers navigating the fragmented advertising market. We bundle proprietary digital solutions with our television and radio inventory. This approach allows us to deliver integrated campaigns and capture a larger share of our clients' advertising budgets.

To execute this strategy, we are expanding our local sales teams and hiring digital specialists to drive the sale of these bundled products. We are also expanding our content capabilities and sourcing unique digital inventory to create additional independent inventory for our sales teams to monetize. In addition to our long-standing affiliation with TelevisaUnivision, we have expanded our local news operations and launched independent networks, such as WAPA Orlando and Altavision, to provide more advertising opportunities for our clients.
We distribute content to inform and entertain our Latino audience. We distribute this content through network affiliations and our own local news programming.

We are the largest affiliate group of the Spanish-language Univision and UniMás networks, which are owned by TelevisaUnivision. We broadcast Univision and UniMás programming exclusively in 21 markets, including 14 of the top 50 Latino markets in the United States. These networks provide our stations with national news, prime time dramas, sports, and entertainment specials. Univision finished 2025 as the most watched broadcast television network by U.S. Latinos, and the top

Spanish-language network in primetime and total day for the 33rd consecutive year among total viewers, adults 25-54 and adults 18-49, according to TelevisaUnivision. Univision and UniMás collectively represent more than half of Spanish language broadcast prime time viewers in the United States.

Our current relationship is governed by an affiliation agreement, a proxy agreement, and a marketing and sales agreement, all of which we entered into in October 2017. These 2017 agreements replaced comparable contracts with TelevisaUnivision.

headings: We operate in highly competitive industries subject to changing technologies, and we may not be able to compete successfully.
We do not have long-term commitments from our advertisers, and we may not be able to retain or attract new advertisers.
While our revenue is variable based on many factors, many of our operating expenses are fixed.
Our business is exposed to risks associated with the creditworthiness of our key advertisers and other strategic business partners.
We are a party to various retransmission consent agreements that may be terminated or not extended following their current termination dates.
Changes in the competitive landscape or technology may impact our ability to monetize our spectrum assets.
We face declining audiences in our television and audio operations.
Our emphasis on enhancing our local news programming as a means to increase advertising revenue may not produce the intended results.
TelevisaUnivision's ownership of our Class U common stock may make some transactions difficult or impossible to complete without TelevisaUnivision's consent.
Risks in Our Advertising Technology & Services Operations
If we fail to maintain and grow our relationships with our advertisers, our business, results of operations and financial condition could be adversely affected.

Reduced advertising inventory or advertising channels or changes in the attractiveness of certain advertising channels could have a material adverse effect on our business, results of operations and financial condition.
If we fail to respond to changes in the digital advertising industry, our business may become less competitive.
We compete with media companies themselves, as well as with other digital advertising companies.
Our use of certain third party platforms could be restricted.
Our systems and IT infrastructure may be subject to security breaches and other cybersecurity incidents.
Our use of AI technologies may increase our cybersecurity risks and harm our business.
Our international operations subject us to significant costs and risks.
We may be exposed to certain risks enforcing our legal rights generally in some of the countries in which we operate.
Currently, our ATS business is dependent on one recently-acquired customer for a significant amount of our ATS revenue, as well as our consolidated revenue.
Our ATS business is subject to various risks associated with the mobile gaming industry.
The technology on which we rely may not be protectable, which could result in competition from others who may utilize the same, or similar technology.
In the past we have experienced, and we may in the future experience, difficulty establishing adequate management and financial controls in some of the countries in which we operate.
Our substantial level of debt could limit our ability to grow and compete.
The Amended Credit Agreement contains various covenants that limit management's discretion in the operation of our business.
Our failure to comply with the financial covenants under the Amended Credit Agreement could have a material adverse effect on our operations and financial condition.

We may need to raise capital if our current liquidity is insufficient to fund business activities. If we cannot raise such on favorable terms or at all, we may have to reduce or curtail certain existing operations.
We expect to experience fluctuations in foreign exchange rates in our overseas operations.

If we cannot renew our FCC broadcast licenses, our broadcast operations would be impaired, which could have a material and adverse effect on our business, results of operations and financial condition.
We are subject to extensive additional regulation by the FCC in our television and radio operations.

Measures we take to protect PII and other confidential information, as required by the laws and regulations to which we are subject, may not be effective, and could expose us to significant liability.
We must comply with the Foreign Corrupt Practices Act.
paragraphs: We operate in highly competitive industries. Our television and radio stations compete for audiences and advertising with other television stations, radio stations and digital media platforms, as well as with other forms of media and content delivery. Advances in technologies and alternative methods of content delivery, as well as changes in audience or advertiser expectations driven by changes in these or other technologies and methods of content delivery across our segments, could have a material adverse effect on our business and results of operations.

New technologies and methods of buying advertising present an additional competitive challenge, as competitors offer products and services such as the ability to purchase advertising programmatically or bundled offline and online advertising, aimed at capturing advertising spend that previously went to broadcasters. Our inability, for technological, business or other reasons, to adapt to changes in program offerings and technology on a timely and effective basis, exploit new sources of revenue from these changes, or to enhance, develop, introduce and deliver compelling advertising solutions in response to changing market conditions and technologies or evolving expectations of advertisers may have a material adverse effect on our business and results of operations.

Our success depends, in part, upon our ability to secure repeat business from existing advertisers, while expanding the number of advertisers for which we provide services. Because we do not have long-term agreements with advertisers, and because advertising insertion orders may be cancelled prior to the completion of the campaign without penalty, subject to payment for advertisements that have already been delivered, we cannot guarantee that our current advertisers will continue to use our services, or that we will be able to replace advertisers who cease using our services with new advertising customers. These events, were they to occur, would have a material adverse effect on our business and results of operations, especially if we are unable to replace such advertising purchases.

Many of our operating expenses are based, at least in part, on our expectations of future revenue and are therefore relatively fixed once budgeted. Weakness in advertising sales or our inability to change some of our fixed operating costs to variable operating costs could narrow profit margins and have a material adverse effect on our business and results of operations.

Periodic economic downturns may result in financial instability or other adverse effects for many of our advertisers and other strategic business partners. Disruption of the credit markets, a prolonged recession and/or sluggish economic growth in future

periods could adversely affect our customers' ability to access credit which supports the continuation and expansion of their businesses and could result in advertising or broadcast cancellations or suspensions, payment delays or defaults by our customers.

paragraphs: The following discussion of our consolidated results of operations and cash flows for the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024 and 2023 and consolidated financial condition as of December 31, 2025 and 2024 should be read in conjunction with our consolidated financial statements and the related notes included elsewhere in this annual report on Form 10-K.

The discussion and analysis of our financial condition and results of operations for 2025 compared to 2024 appears below. As a smaller reporting company, we have chosen to omit the discussion and analysis of our financial condition and results of operations for 2024 compared to 2023.

We are a global media and advertising technology company. We have organized our operations into two reportable segments, media and ATS, and we manage and report our financial results through these two operating segments.

Our Media business owns and operates one of the largest groups of Spanish-language television and radio stations in the United States. Our mission is to serve our Latino audience as a trusted provider of news, information, and entertainment. We serve our advertisers by providing marketing capabilities across broadcast and digital media.

Our ATS business empowers advertisers, primarily mobile app developers, to grow their businesses globally. We provide programmatic advertising solutions through two brands. Smadex is our demand-side platform, which uses proprietary AI to automate media buying. Adwake is our performance-based digital marketing agency.

In 2024, we discontinued and divested a significant portion of our operations, which consisted primarily of several acquisitions that had been completed prior to 2024, and which operations comprised the majority of our former digital segment.

Our net revenue for the year ended December 31, 2025 was $447.6 million. Of this amount, revenue generated by our media segment accounted for approximately 39%, and revenue generated by our advertising technology & services segment accounted for approximately 61% of total revenue.
See "Item 1. Business" for detailed information about our business, the industry in which we operate, certain industry trends and important recent business developments.

During the year ended December 31, 2025, our revenue grew by double digits, driven primarily by revenue growth of 90% in our advertising technology & services segment, partially offset by a decrease in revenue in our media segment compared to the year ended December 31, 2024. In addition, during the year ended December 31, 2025:
• investments in the AI capabilities of our platform and increased sales capacity enabled ATS to increase monthly active advertisers and revenue per monthly active advertiser.
• amended our original 2023 Credit Agreement, or the original 2023 Credit Agreement, to provide more financial flexibility and accelerate debt reduction.
• we continued to reduce our debt by making a voluntary prepayment of $10 million and scheduled amortization payments of $10 million under our Credit Facility.

• management began to implement an ongoing organization design plan (the "Plan") to support revenue growth and reduce expenses, primarily in our media operations. As management continues to implement the Plan, and evaluate its early results, further changes may be made if management believes that is appropriate. For more details see Note 2 to Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements.
See Note 3 to Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements for details. RESULTS OF OPERATIONS

paragraphs: 本公司與其全資子公司Entravision Communications Corporation之業務說明，係截至本申報書申報日為止，除非另有說明。
Entravision為一媒體與廣告科技公司。
本公司之媒體業務擁有並營運美國規模最大的西班牙語電視與廣播電臺羣之一。本公司之使命為作為可信賴的資訊、新聞與娛樂提供者，服務拉丁美洲族羣。本公司透過廣播與數位媒體提供行銷能力，服務廣告客戶。
本公司之廣告科技與服務（ATS）業務，協助主要為行動應用開發者之廣告客戶，於全球範圍內拓展業務。本公司透過兩個品牌提供程序化廣告解決方案。Smadex為本公司之需求端平台，運用專屬AI技術自動執行媒體採購。Adwake為本公司之績效導向數位行銷機構。
本公司透過這兩個營運分部報告財務成果：媒體與ATS。
本公司擁有並營運美國規模最大的西班牙語電視與廣播電臺羣之一。本公司資產包含47座電視臺與44座廣播電臺。這些電臺集中於美國20個拉丁美洲族羣密度最高市場中的13個。本公司亦為針對拉丁美洲消費者之企業提供數位行銷服務。
我們將廣告主與這重要的受眾連結。我們的媒體應報告分部是我們市場中廣告主的單一來源。我們相信我們在當地市場的實力與關係，使我們能成為廣告主在面對碎片化廣告市場時的可信賴夥伴。我們將專利的數位解決方案與電視與廣播的存貨結合。這種方式使我們能提供整合性的行銷方案，並佔據較大的客戶廣告預算份額。
為執行此策略，我們正在擴充當地銷售團隊，並聘請數位專才以推動這些整合產品的銷售。我們同時也在擴充內容能力，並尋找獨特的數位存貨，以創造額外的獨立存貨供銷售團隊進行 monetization。除了我們與 TelevisaUnivision 長久的合作關係外，我們也擴充了當地新聞業務，並啟動了獨立的網路，例如 WAPA Orlando 和 Altavision，以提供更多廣告機會給我們的客戶。
我們透過網路合作與我們自己的地方新聞節目，來傳播內容以資訊與娛樂我們的拉丁美洲受眾。

本公司為西班牙語系 Univision 與 UniMás 網路最大的加盟集團，該網路為 TelevisaUnivision 所擁有。本公司於 21 個市場獨家播送 Univision 與 UniMás 的節目，包括美國 50 大拉丁市場中的 14 個。這些網路為本公司電臺提供全國新聞、黃金時段連續劇、體育與娛樂特別節目。根據 TelevisaUnivision 的資料，Univision 在 2025 年成為美國拉丁族羣觀看人數最多的廣播電視網，並連續 33 年在總觀眾、25-54 歲成人及 18-49 歲成人中，為西班牙語系網路在黃金時段及全天時段的收視冠軍。
Univision 與 UniMás 合計代表美國西班牙語系廣播電視黃金時段觀眾人數超過一半。
本公司目前的關係由一份加盟協議、一份代理協議及一份行銷與銷售協議所規範，這些協議均於 2017 年 10 月簽訂。這些 2017 年的協議取代了與 TelevisaUnivision 簽訂的類似契約。

paragraphs: 以下關於我們合併後營運成果與現金流之討論，以及截至2025年12月31日及2024年12月31日之合併財務狀況，應與我們之合併財務報表及相關附註說明一併閱讀，這些財務報表及附註說明載於本10-K年度報告之其他部分。
2025年財務狀況與營運成果之討論與分析如下。由於本公司為小型申報公司，我們選擇省略2024年與2023年財務狀況與營運成果之討論與分析。
本公司為一全球性媒體與廣告科技公司。我們已將營運業務劃分為兩個應報告分部，即媒體與ATS，並透過這兩個營運分部管理與報告財務成果。
我們之媒體業務擁有並營運美國最大規模之一組西班牙語電視與廣播電臺羣組。我們的使命是作為一個受信賴的資訊來源，為拉丁美洲觀眾提供新聞、資訊與娛樂。我們透過廣播與數位媒體之行銷能力，為廣告客戶提供服務。
我們之ATS業務協助廣告客戶，主要是行動應用程式開發者，於全球範圍內拓展業務。我們透過兩個品牌提供程式化廣告解決方案。Smadex為我們之需求端平台，使用專屬AI技術自動執行媒體採購。Adwake為我們之績效導向數位行銷機構。
2024年，我們終止並出售了我們營運業務中相當大一部分，這些營運業務主要為數個於2024年之前完成之收購，且這些業務組成我們前數位分部之絕大部分。
詳情請參閱『項目1.業務』，以瞭解本公司業務、所屬產業、某些產業趨勢及重要近期業務發展等資訊。
於2025年12月31日財務年度，本公司營業收入成長為雙位數，主要驅動因素為廣告科技與服務分部營業收入成長90%，部分抵銷媒體分部相較於2024年12月31日財務年度營業收入減少。此外，於2025年12月31日財務年度：
• 對平台AI能力的投資與銷售能力提升，使ATS能增加每月活躍廣告客戶數與每月活躍廣告客戶平均營收。
• 修正我們原始的2023年信貸協議，或原始的2023年信貸協議，以提供更多的財務彈性並加速債務減免。
• 本公司持續減少債務，透過信貸設施下自願預先償還10百萬美元與定期償還款項10百萬美元。
• 管理階層開始實施一項持續的組織設計計畫（"計畫"），以支援營收成長與降低成本，主要為媒體運營部分。隨著管理階層持續執行計畫並評估初期成果，若管理階層認為適當，可能進行進一步調整。有關更多細節，請參閱財務會計彙編附註第2項。

headings: 我們從事高度競爭的產業，受技術變遷影響，我們可能無法成功競爭。
我們與廣告客戶沒有長期契約，我們可能無法留住或吸引新廣告客戶。
雖然我們的營業收入會因多種因素而變動，但我們許多營運費用為固定成本。
我們的業務面臨與關鍵廣告客戶及其他戰略商業夥伴信用worthiness相關的風險。
我們是多項重新傳輸同意協議的一方，這些協議可能在現行終止日期後終止或未續約。
重新傳輸同意收入可能減少。
競爭環境或技術的變動可能影響我們對頻譜資產的 monetize 能力。
我們在電視及音訊業務中面臨觀眾數量下降的風險。
我們透過加強地方新聞節目以增加廣告收入的策略，可能無法達到預期的成效。
TelevisaUnivision 持有我們 Class U 普通股的股權，可能使某些交易在未經 TelevisaUnivision 同意的情況下變得困難或無法完成。
我們廣告科技與服務業務的風險
若我們未能維持並拓展與廣告客戶的關係，將可能對我們的業務、營運結果及財務狀況造成不利影響。
廣告存貨或廣告渠道減少，或某些廣告渠道吸引力發生變化，可能對我們的業務、營運結果及財務狀況造成重大不利影響。
若我們未能回應數位廣告產業的變化，將可能使我們的業務變得較不具競爭力。
我們與媒體公司本身以及其他數位廣告公司競爭。
本公司使用某些第三方平台之情形可能受到限制。
本公司之系統及資訊科技基礎建設可能遭受安全漏洞及其他網路安全事件之影響。
本公司使用人工智慧技術可能增加本公司之網路安全風險，並對本公司業務造成損害。
本公司之國際業務使本公司面臨顯著之成本與風險。
本公司可能因在部分營運國家執行法律權利而面臨特定風險。
目前，本公司之ATS業務依賴一 recently-acquired 客戶，該客戶為本公司ATS收入以及合併收入之重要來源。
本公司之ATS業務面臨與行動遊戲產業相關之各種風險。
本公司所倚靠之技術可能無法受到保護，此情形可能導致其他競爭對手利用相同或類似技術進行競爭。
過去我們曾經驗過，且未來可能再次經驗，在我們營運之部分國家建立適當之管理及財務控制機制之困難。
本公司目前負擔之高額債務可能限制我們成長與競爭之能力。
修正後之信貸協議包含若干條款，限制管理階層對本公司營運之自主權。
本公司若未能遵守修正後信貸協議之財務條款，將對我們營運與財務狀況造成重大不利影響。
我們可能需要籌措資金，若目前之流動性不足以支應營運活動。若無法以有利條件或完全無法籌措資金，我們可能必須削減或中止部分現有營運。
我們預期在海外營運中會經驗外匯匯率之波動。
若我們無法續約 FCC 廣播執照，將導致廣播營運受損，可能對本公司業務、營運成果及財務狀況造成重大且不利的影響。
我們的電視及廣播營運須接受 FCC 的廣泛額外監管。

本公司必須遵守外國貪腐防治法（Foreign Corrupt Practices Act）。
paragraphs: 我們經營於高度競爭的產業。我們的電視與廣播電臺與其他電視臺、廣播電臺及數位媒體平台，以及其他形式的媒體與內容傳輸方式競爭觀眾與廣告業務。技術的進步與替代性的內容傳輸方式，以及因這些或其它技術與內容傳輸方式的變動而引發的觀眾或廣告客戶期望的改變，可能對我們的業務與營運成果產生重大不利影響。
新技術與廣告購買方式帶來額外的競爭挑戰，因為競爭對手提供如程式化購買廣告或整合離線與線上廣告等產品與服務，以爭取原本流向廣播公司的廣告支出。我們若因技術、業務或其他原因，無法及時且有效地適應節目內容與技術的變動，無法從這些變動中開拓新的收入來源，或無法提升、開發、推出並提供具吸引力的廣告解決方案以回應市場條件與技術的變動，或廣告客戶的期待變化，可能對我們的業務與營運成果產生重大不利影響。

我們的成功在一定程度上取決於我們能否從現有廣告客戶獲得重複業務，同時擴大為我們提供服務的廣告客戶數量。由於我們與廣告客戶沒有長期契約，且廣告插入訂單可能在活動完成前取消，且不需支付罰款（僅需支付已交付廣告的費用），我們無法保證現有廣告客戶會持續使用我們的服務，或我們能否替停止使用我們服務的廣告客戶找到新的廣告客戶。若這些情況發生，將對我們的業務與營運成果產生重大不利影響，特別是在我們無法替換這些廣告支出的情況下。
本公司許多營運費用係基於對未來營業收入的預期，至少部分為此而設定，因此一旦預算確定後，相對而言屬固定費用。若廣告銷售表現不佳，或本公司無法將部分固定營運費用轉為變動營運費用，可能導致利潤率收窄，並對本公司業務及營運成果產生重大不利影響。
